fields.statement: Verifier at 7420691c (attempt 2): go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdogStalled|TestWatchdogPolicy' passes. TestWatchdogStalled, with a fixed clock, a temp session store and fake send/stop/resume, nudges both autonomous runs at 21m (none at 19m), stops and resumes only run A at 41m with exactly one 'stopped and resumed' log line and Spent=1, leaves run B alone after it reported progress at 30m, and gives owner-attended run O only a hold that becomes an InboxStalled item, never a stop or resume. The fix commit's diff: StallLimit now takes the step's timeout, and a wait step gets max(waitLimit, timeout+10m), covered by the new 'wait step outlives its timeout' subtest (2h -> 2h10m, 10m -> 90m, own stall wins). run.Terminate signals -pid when the pid leads its group; detached runs start with Setsid and step commands inherit that group. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/run -run TestTerminateStopsGroup passes: a group leader's background sleep child dies with it. gofmt -l and go vet are clean on internal/api and internal/run.
